title: OpenAI claims solution to Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
summary: OpenAI announced that its AI system solved one of mathematics' seven Millennium Prize Problems, proving the Navier-Stokes equations can develop singularities in finite time. The breakthrough, achieved in 88 hours using 10,000 AI agents, carries a $1 million prize but faces scrutiny over credit attribution.
popularity_basis: Historic mathematical breakthrough covered by Nature, NYT, CNBC, and Axios with significant scientific and industry implications.

title: Apple unveils iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo foldable, and new wearables
summary: Apple announced the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with A20 Pro chip, variable aperture cameras, and record battery life, plus the foldable iPhone Duo. Pre-orders begin September 12 with availability on September 18, starting at $1,199 and $1,299 respectively.
popularity_basis: Major Apple product launch with foldable iPhone debut, widely covered across tech media with significant consumer interest.

title: Legal AI startup Harvey raises $550M at $15.5B valuation
summary: Harvey, the legal AI company, secured $550 million in funding co-led by Diffusion and Lightspeed Venture Partners, reaching a $15.5 billion valuation just months after hitting $11 billion. The round reflects intense investor demand for legal AI solutions.
popularity_basis: Major funding round with rapid valuation growth, covered by TechCrunch, Legal Tech News, and Dealroom with strong VC interest.

title: Automattic board forces WordPress founder Matt Mullenweg on leave
summary: Automattic's board placed CEO and founder Matt Mullenweg on paid leave against his will, appointing CFO Mark Davies as interim CEO. Mullenweg alleged board members conspired behind his back in an internal Slack message seen by TechCrunch.
popularity_basis: Major leadership shakeup at WordPress parent company, covered by TechCrunch, The Verge, and 404 Media with significant industry attention.

title: Anthropic researcher quits over AI safety concerns
summary: Jacob Coxon, an AI researcher at Anthropic with prior OpenAI experience, publicly resigned citing irresponsible AI development practices. He warned both companies are racing toward self-improving superintelligence while gambling with humanity's safety.
popularity_basis: High-profile AI safety resignation covered by AP News, Fortune, PBS, TIME, and CNBC with significant social media engagement.

title: Google commits $15B to AI infrastructure and nuclear power in Finland
summary: Google announced a €13 billion ($15B) investment in Finnish digital infrastructure through 2028, including data centers and a 22-year nuclear power purchase agreement with Fortum to extend the Loviisa plant's life to 2050.
popularity_basis: Major infrastructure investment with first European nuclear PPA, covered by WSJ, Bloomberg, Google Cloud Press Corner, and DW.

title: Qualcomm and Amazon strike $60B AI chip partnership
summary: Qualcomm announced a multi-generation deal with Amazon to develop custom AI inference chips and 1.6T optical connectivity for AWS data centers. Amazon received warrants to purchase up to $4 billion in Qualcomm stock tied to the partnership.
popularity_basis: Major semiconductor-AI deal with $60B potential value, covered by Manufacturing Dive, Yahoo Finance, Channel Insider, and TechZine.

title: Defense startup Covenant emerges with $250M and missile factory
summary: Covenant exited stealth with over $250 million in funding led by Andreessen Horowitz and Founders Fund, unveiling the Anthem long-range cruise missile and opening a 105,000-square-foot Texas factory with plans for mass production in Q1 2027.
popularity_basis: Major defense tech emergence with production facility, covered by Dallas Innovates, The Next Web, Seeking Alpha, and Ground News.

title: OpenAI adds AI safety researcher Paul Christiano to board
summary: OpenAI appointed Paul Christiano, an influential AI alignment researcher, to its Foundation board of directors. The move signals increased focus on AI safety governance amid industry concerns about uncontrollable AI systems.
popularity_basis: Notable AI governance appointment covered by TechCrunch, Yahoo News, and Financial Times with safety community attention.

title: Uber invests $10M in Indian fleet operator Carrum at $168M valuation
summary: Uber invested $10 million in Carrum Mobility's Series B round, valuing the Indian fleet management startup at ₹16 billion ($168 million). Uber now holds a mid-teens stake as it expands reliance on fleet operators in India.
popularity_basis: Significant India-focused mobility investment covered by TechCrunch, Yahoo Finance, and LinkedIn with regional relevance.

title: Cymphony exits stealth with $30M for AI agent security
summary: Enterprise AI security startup Cymphony raised $30 million in a Series A co-led by Sequoia Capital and SMBC Fin Atlas Beyond Fund, valuing the company above $100 million. The startup helps enterprises track and control AI agents accessing their systems.
popularity_basis: Notable AI security funding from top-tier VC, covered by TechCrunch, Yahoo Finance, and AI Weekly with enterprise security relevance.

title: Tesla Cybercab faces federal safety probe over certification
summary: NHTSA opened a formal investigation into how Tesla certified its Cybercab robotaxis to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards. The probe examines Tesla's determination that certain standards are inapplicable to vehicles lacking conventional manual controls.
popularity_basis: Federal regulatory action on autonomous vehicles, covered by WardsAuto and multiple EV outlets with safety implications.

title: FTC opens antitrust probe into Epic Systems
summary: The Federal Trade Commission reportedly launched an antitrust investigation into Epic Systems, the dominant electronic health records vendor. The probe focuses on whether Epic restricts competitor access to patient data, though Epic denies anticompetitive conduct.
popularity_basis: Major healthcare IT antitrust action reported by Reuters and JD Supra with significant industry implications.

title: System raises $20M for vertically integrated peptide platform
summary: Health startup System secured $20 million to expand its peptide telehealth platform connecting patients with licensed clinicians and pharmacy-grade compound treatments. Investors include Patron Fund, Will Ventures, and SV Angel.
popularity_basis: Notable health tech funding covered by PR Newswire, Dealroom, and Athletech News amid growing peptide therapy market.

title: Bulwark Dynamics raises $6.8M for autonomous landing craft
summary: Defense startup Bulwark Dynamics secured $6.8 million in seed funding to produce its Caravel autonomous landing craft, partnering with Japan's Onomichi Dockyard for manufacturing. The unmanned vessels resupply forces across shorelines without port infrastructure.
popularity_basis: Defense tech funding with international manufacturing partnership, covered by Business Wire, Dealroom, and Tectonic Defense.

title: Overroute raises $5.5M for AI freight execution platform
summary: AI-native freight execution startup Overroute secured $5.5 million led by UP.Partners to expand its platform used by J.B. Hunt. The funding will accelerate AI agents that automate load monitoring and exception handling for large carriers.
popularity_basis: Logistics AI funding covered by FreightWaves, Business Wire, and StockTitan with enterprise deployment traction.

title: FTC withdraws 2021 health app breach policy statement
summary: The Federal Trade Commission rescinded its 2021 Policy Statement on Breaches by Health Apps, calling it obsolete after 2024 rule updates expanded the Health Breach Notification Rule to cover health apps and connected devices directly.
popularity_basis: Regulatory policy change covered by FTC.gov and MLex with privacy and health tech implications.

title: SpaceX launches classified Space Force payload
summary: SpaceX successfully launched its 80th Starlink mission of 2026 and prepared to fly a classified national security payload for the U.S. Space Force from Cape Canaveral. The company also plans to launch the final three O3b mPOWER satellites for SES.
popularity_basis: Ongoing space launch activity covered by Florida Today, MyNews13, and Spaceflight Now with defense and satellite relevance.

title: Latitude raises $35M Series A for cross-border payments
summary: Global payments infrastructure startup Latitude secured $35 million in Series A funding to simplify cross-border money movement. The round supports expansion of the Houston-based company's international payment rails.
popularity_basis: Fintech funding covered by VC News Daily with cross-border payments market relevance.

title: Savvy Wealth closes $100M Series C for AI-native RIA
summary: AI-native registered investment advisor Savvy Wealth completed a $100 million Series C funding round. The New York-based company provides AI-powered wealth management tools for independent financial advisors.
popularity_basis: Major fintech funding covered by VC News Daily with AI and wealth management intersection.

title: Encoded Therapeutics raises $275M in Series F
summary: Clinical-stage biotechnology company Encoded Therapeutics closed a $275 million Series F financing round. The South San Francisco-based company develops genetic medicines for severe neurological disorders.
popularity_basis: Large biotech funding covered by VC News Daily with significant capital raise in gene therapy sector.

title: Xiaomi expands Mijia smart home brand across Europe at IFA 2026
summary: Xiaomi announced large-scale expansion of its Mijia smart home brand across Europe at IFA 2026, showcasing its Human × Car × Home ecosystem. The company also unveiled three new in-house AI chips at the Berlin trade show.
popularity_basis: Major consumer electronics showcase covered by Variety and Xiaomi's official channels at IFA 2026.

title: Marvell to showcase AI data center connectivity portfolio
summary: Marvell announced it will display its end-to-end AI data center connectivity and memory solutions at AI Infra Summit 2026 in Santa Clara, September 15-17. The semiconductor company highlights scale-up and scale-out infrastructure advances.
popularity_basis: Semiconductor product showcase covered by Marvell investor relations with AI infrastructure relevance.

title: GCs and Wilson Sonsini launch legal tech VC fund
summary: A group of general counsels partnered with Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati to launch GCVC, a venture capital fund for legal technology startups. The fund already has over 50 general counsels invested and backed AI-native legal software companies.
popularity_basis: Legal tech funding vehicle covered by ABA Journal and Reuters with institutional investor participation.

title: Autonomous AI agents compromise thousands of credentials in hours
summary: Security researchers documented a financially motivated hacking group using an autonomous multi-agent AI framework to harvest thousands of credentials within six hours. The attack demonstrates how threat actors leverage AI to accelerate operations.
popularity_basis: AI-powered cyberattack documentation covered by The Hacker News with security industry implications.
